prompt: Use case: logo-brand. A radical brand identity exploration for "perry" (exact letters p e r r y, with TWO separately legible r letters), a Mac companion that guides by drawing and acts on the screen. Direction name "Hotwire". Create an exquisitely crafted landscape 3:2 brand board. The visual thesis: a single gesture reaches from one place to another, catches the task, and pulls. Invent a new trademark symbol, NOT a letter P: a continuous wide flat vermilion strip with two opposed hooked ends and a sharply pinched diagonal middle. Like a bent double-ended cartoon magnet or stretched sideways jaw, angular tension, deliberately asymmetrical, with one circular interior cutout at one end and one clipped wedge opening at the other. Exactly one bold simple silhouette with no eyes. No infinity loop, no chain links, no lightning bolt, no generic swoosh. Make it strange and instantly drawable from memory. This mark must feel like ACTION as a living graphic, and must work flat at 16 pixels. Palette hot vermilion #FF3B26, espresso #26120D, warm butter #FFF0B8, chalk #FFFBF4. Do NOT make another conventional lowercase p logo. Build the identity's expressive alphabet from this same strip: a stretched state and a compact hooked state shown sparingly. Predominantly flat vector-like design with one beautiful vermilion matte-rubber closeup. Compose as a genuinely experimental design studio identity spread with massive typography cut by the gestural mark, elegantly broken composition, large red and butter fields. Avoid the ordinary big-render-left / wordmark-right layout. The readable lowercase wordmark "perry" in dark espresso, custom broad warm grotesk, two r letters readable with clean spacing. Include one macOS app icon showing the SAME compact double-hook symbol, one monochrome mark, small-size reductions, and four palette chips with the above hex labels. Huge differences in scale and deliberate breathing room. No merchandise, dashboard, text paragraphs, labels everywhere, registration grids, ornamental lines or numbers. Fully opaque edge-to-edge. This must look like a new graphic language rather than a letter-logo presentation. Small caption Hotwire only.

Use case: logo-brand. Invent a far more original visual identity for "perry" (p e r r y), a Mac assistant living at the top edge of the screen and reaching into your work. Concept name "Foldspace". Landscape 3:2 art-directed brand identity image only, no UI or website. The concept: THE EDGE IS ALIVE. Hero trademark is NOT a letter P. Invent a folded bracket, a wide flat rectangular band open at lower right, with two abrupt 90-degree folds, a signature chamfered corner and one offset notch. The same contour should be read as a screen edge in flat silhouette, and as an impossible little architectural doorway when extruded. Very bold thick silhouette, no thin line icon. The negative space is as authored as the mass. This is the shape that can hug a screen corner, fold open into help, and flatten back into a menu-bar glyph. Show the ONE identical bracket geometry in a breathtaking satin-silver sculptural render, a completely flat cobalt version, a small icon, and a single expanded folded state. Main board composition is a stark cobalt field #1246FF occupying most of the canvas with a huge silver bracket cut hard by the top edge, while a porcelain #EFF1F3 lower strip carries the clean lowercase "perry" wordmark and four precise flat swatches: #1246FF #EFF1F3 #B9C5D1 #171B22. Typography compact, beautifully kerned engineered grotesk, not sci-fi stencil. The sculptural shape should have one stunning visual depth reversal and impossible folded-sheet precision, a brushed silver exterior and cobalt interior. Integrate type composition with the negative space rather than a standard big object on left and logo panel on right. Exact same silhouette in the small flat icon. No letter P, no cube, no rounded ribbon, no infinity knot, no metallic generic blob. No gradients in the field, no glow or neon, no fake technical drafting labels, crosshairs or busy grids. Insanely precise high-end industrial-art visual, a brand about topology and useful spatial intelligence. Entire canvas fully opaque. Show meaningful negative space and a powerful recognizable flat trademark, with the art rendering clearly secondary to the trademark idea.
